chapters.title: The Car That Stopped
p: Tom was driving to work. His car stopped in the middle of the road. He tried to start it, but it did not work. He called his friend Mike.
Mike came quickly. He looked at the car and said, 'It's broken. We need to fix it.' Tom was worried. He did not know what to do.
They waited for an hour. Then a man came and helped. He fixed the car quickly. Tom thanked him with a smile.
Tom drove home happily. He said, 'I am glad the car is fixed.' Mike laughed and said, 'You are lucky today.'
tr: Tom işe gidiyordu. Arabası yolun ortasında durdu. Başlatmaya çalıştı ama işe yaramadı. Arkadaşı Mike'ı aradı.
